questions.prompt: What length must each of the four sides have?

choices.label: The total stick length divided by the number of sticks.
choices.feedback: Using every stick for four equal sides requires the total length to divide evenly by four.

choices.label: One quarter of the total stick length, with no remainder.
choices.feedback: Using every stick for four equal sides requires the total length to divide evenly by four.

choices.label: The longest individual stick’s length.
choices.feedback: Using every stick for four equal sides requires the total length to divide evenly by four.

questions.prompt: Which side may receive the current stick?

choices.label: Any side whose new total would not exceed the target length.
choices.feedback: A side that exceeds its final target cannot be repaired later because stick lengths are positive.

choices.label: Any side, even if it becomes longer than the target.
choices.feedback: A side that exceeds its final target cannot be repaired later because stick lengths are positive.

choices.label: Only a side that already has the largest total.
choices.feedback: A side that exceeds its final target cannot be repaired later because stick lengths are positive.

questions.prompt: What should happen when a stick placement leads to failure?

choices.label: Leave the stick there and try placing another copy.
choices.feedback: A failed choice does not rule out other side assignments. Restore the side length before exploring an alternative.

choices.label: Reject the entire input after the first failed placement.
choices.feedback: A failed choice does not rule out other side assignments. Restore the side length before exploring an alternative.

choices.label: Undo that placement and try another side.
